definition: occupied=1, empty=0 for occupancy prediction; evaluation flips the positive class so Empty=1 for recommendations.
occupied is derived from occ_count_max > 0.0; any detected occupant in either south-zone sensor marks the 15-minute interval occupied.
anchor_time is the left label of a completed 15-minute input bin [t, t+15 min); its effective availability boundary is anchor_time + 15 minutes and the first target begins at that boundary.
